listItems.heading: Individuals:
listItems.desc: Salaried employees, freelancers, and self-employed professionals.

listItems.heading: Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs):
listItems.desc: Joint families with shared income.

listItems.heading: Partnership Firms and LLPs:
listItems.desc: Business entities with multiple owners.

listItems.heading: Companies:
listItems.desc: Private and public companies operating in India.

listItems.heading: Associations of Persons (AOP) and Body of Individuals (BOI):
listItems.desc: Groups earning collective income.

income.heading: 💡 Types of Income Under Income Tax

listItems.heading: Income from Salary:
listItems.desc: Earnings from employment, including salary, bonuses, and allowances.

listItems.heading: Income from House Property:
listItems.desc: Rental income from owned properties.

listItems.heading: Income from Business or Profession:
listItems.desc: Profits from businesses or self-employment.

listItems.heading: Income from Capital Gains:
listItems.desc: Profits from the sale of property, stocks, or assets.

listItems.heading: Income from Other Sources:
listItems.desc: Interest, dividends, lottery winnings, and gifts.

deduction.heading: 🪙 Income Tax Deductions and Exemptions for 2025

listItems.heading: Section 80C:
listItems.desc: Deduction of up to ₹1.5 lakh for investments in PPF, NSC, ELSS, and life insurance premiums.

listItems.heading: Section 80D:
listItems.desc: Deduction for health insurance premiums (₹25,000 for individuals and ₹50,000 for senior citizens).

listItems.heading: Section 80G:
listItems.desc: Deduction for donations to charities and relief funds.

listItems.heading: Section 24(b):
listItems.desc: Deduction of up to ₹2 lakh on home loan interest payments.

listItems.heading: Standard Deduction:
listItems.desc: ₹75,000 for salaried individuals and pensioners.

itr.heading: 📅 How to File Income Tax Online (ITR) in India

listItems.desc: Visit the official portal: www.incometax.gov.in
Register/Login using your PAN as the user ID.
Select the ITR Form based on your income source.
Fill in the details: Enter your income, deductions, and tax payments.
Verify your ITR using Aadhaar OTP, net banking, or digital signature.
Submit and download the ITR-V acknowledgment for your records.
Last date to file ITR for individuals and HUFs.
Last date to file ITR for companies and audit-required entities.
Deadline for belated or revised ITR filing.

penalties.heading: ⚠️ Income Tax Penalties for Late Filing

listItems.desc: ₹5,000 if filed after July 31 but before December 31.
₹10,000 if filed after December 31.
₹1,000 for individuals with income below ₹5 lakh.

conclusion.heading: 📢 Conclusion
conclusion.para:
Understanding the new income tax slabs in India 2025 and available deductions can help you reduce your tax liability. With zero tax for income up to ₹12 lakh and simplified online filing, taxpayers can save more while complying with the law. Ensure you file your ITR before July 31, 2025, to avoid penalties and maximize tax benefits.

Stay updated with the latest tax regulations by visiting the official Income Tax Department website.
